🔄 Content Update (Published: August 28, 2026 / Previously posted: August 29, 2026)
Key change: Parking information has been updated. Previously only "Please use Hanno City Hall parking," but now clarifies that parking space on the venue grounds is limited.

A Mental Health Forum will be held.

【Speaker】 Kosuke Akiyama, certified psychologist and clinical psychologist. Drawing on experience with return-to-work support and counseling at clinics and companies in Tokyo and Minami-Hanno Hospital, he will discuss practical psychological skills and healthy stress management techniques you can use in daily life.

【Date & Time】 Thursday, October 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 2:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m. (Doors open 1:30 p.m.)

【Venue】 Fujimi District Administrative Center Meeting Room, Hanno City (1-16 Oaza Futayanagi, Hanno)

【Capacity】 100 people (first come, first served)

【Target】 No restrictions stated

【Fee】 Free

【Application Deadline】 Friday, September 25, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 4:30 p.m.

【How to Apply】 Online form, fax (042-974-6558), or phone (042-974-3488). When applying by fax, include your address, name, kana spelling, and phone number.

【Other Information】 Sign language interpretation available; request by Tuesday, September 8, 2026 (Reiwa 8). Please use Hanno City Hall parking.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/14150.html
